extraction.Name: Louise Waugh
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. I could never see any reason for the issuance of the patent without my asking for it. I have always had the impression that one had to make an application for a patent before receiving it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: after I mortgaged it I could do nothing better as there was taxes and interest to pay
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband helps me some and I raise chickens garden and so forth
extraction.NOTES: Has three children but they are all of age and taking care of themselves. Mortgaged land for something over $2000; when finally sold, most of the proceeds went to pay the mortgage. States she made application for one patent but did not ask for the patent for SE/4 30-99-74. Patent was mailed to her. Not satisfied with the patent and sale of land. Affidavit sworn April 26, 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32. Document number 6477.
